nodes.label: Task-Board Rule (Three Artefacts, One Daily Habit)
nodes.rationale: Tag In progress in the xlsx during the day with Owner and Date Started; at end of day update the Google Sheet to match whatever state tasks are in — a task left Blocked there when finished is a teammate idle tomorrow. Reference the task ID in branch name and commit message. No spreadsheet is committed.

nodes.label: Always-Use-Graphify Rule (Baseline Copy)
nodes.rationale: Repo carries a persistent knowledge graph in graphify-out/; treat codebase/architecture/content questions as graphify queries first, fall back to direct file tools only when graphify can't answer, re-run ingestion after material changes.
